info.name: ChatGPT Glass
info.description: ChatGPT but upgraded with a modern glass morphism style to make your ChatGPT experience just a bit nicer :)
info.additionalInfo:
Glassmorphism UI for ChatGPT

A modern glassmorphism theme for ChatGPT that transforms the interface into a cohesive, frosted-glass experience. Inspired by cyberpunk sunsets and contemporary UI systems, it blends soft neumorphic depth with a vibrant gradient accent to create a calm yet expressive workspace.

Designed for creators, designers, and power users who want ChatGPT to feel less utilitarian and more intentional.

Features

Unified glassmorphism across all UI panels

Cyber Sunset gradient accent (pink → violet)

Soft neumorphic shadows for depth without clutter

Enhanced chat focus and visual hierarchy

Stylus-safe, lightweight, and easy to customise

Best experienced in Chromium-based browsers.
